_readme: Pairs of formula ids that legitimately share (or nearly share) a full
composition signature — acknowledged by Ting, not a mis-join.
This file is read by scripts/validate-formula-composition-signatures.js.
It stays in scripts/ (not data/config/) because this task's dispatch
restricts edits to scripts/ and docs/ only — see FB-20 work order,
docs/research_packs/FORMULA_EYESON_02.md.
When to add a pair here vs. when NOT to:
ADD    a legitimate shared-base design decision has been made and
recorded — e.g. two dosage forms of one classical formula
that are deliberately kept as two cards with identical ratios,
or an accepted 加減 variant whose only change has not yet been
filled in. Requires a `reason`, `decided_by`, and `date`.
DO NOT add a pair just to silence a real defect (a mis-join, a
copy-paste from the wrong record, an unresolved duplicate-
record governance question). Those stay reported — see F-32
and F-41 in FORMULA_EYESON_02.md. The validator already
auto-recognizes review_status:"deprecated" as a resolved
duplicate without needing an entry here (constitution 紅線 2:
retirement is deprecation, not deletion — deprecating the
losing id IS the fix).

schema.reason: string — why this pair is legitimately allowed to share a signature
